description:
Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com.

About this position:

As an Enterprise Account Director at Later, you will own a portfolio of our most strategic enterprise client relationships, typically representing $5M-$15M in annual business depending on account size and complexity.

You will operate as the CEO of the account, with significant autonomy and accountability for setting the account strategy, building executive relationships, driving expansion, and determining how Later should invest to deepen and grow each partnership.

This is a senior commercial and strategic leadership role within the evolving creator and influencer marketing ecosystem. You will advise some of the world’s leading brands on how influencer and creator marketing can support broader brand, commerce, customer acquisition, and growth objectives, while helping them navigate a rapidly changing social landscape.

You will bring a strong point of view on creator strategy, social trends, measurement, and the influencer ecosystem, while translating client business priorities into meaningful opportunities for Later. Success in this role requires strong commercial instincts, executive presence, strategic thinking, and the ability to navigate complex enterprise organizations with a high degree of independence.

What you'll be doing:

Enterprise Account Strategy & Growth

  • Own the long-term strategy and growth plan for a portfolio of strategic enterprise clients representing approximately $5M-$15M in annual business.
  • Develop a clear growth thesis for each account, including expansion opportunities, stakeholder strategy, competitive dynamics, risks, and areas where Later can create additional value.
  • Drive expansion by identifying whitespace, developing opportunities, and building the executive alignment required to increase Later’s strategic and commercial footprint.
  • Connect client business priorities to opportunities across influencer marketing, creator strategy, social, commerce, and Later’s broader capabilities.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of each partnership, anticipating changes in client priorities, organizational structure, competitive dynamics, and the broader creator and social landscape.
  • Partner with Sales on commercial strategy, renewals, and expansion while maintaining overall ownership of the client relationship and account direction.

Executive Relationship Leadership

  • Build trusted relationships with VP, C-suite, and senior decision-makers across complex enterprise organizations.
  • Develop multi-threaded relationships that extend beyond individual champions and create durable executive sponsorship for Later.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to clients, bringing proactive recommendations and a clear point of view on creator strategy, influencer marketing, social trends, measurement, and emerging opportunities.
  • Help senior marketers understand how creator and influencer programs can support broader brand, performance, commerce, and customer growth objectives.
  • Lead strategic business reviews, executive strategy sessions, workshops, and other high-value client engagements.
  • Navigate complex or sensitive client conversations with confidence, judgment, and a solutions-oriented approach.

CEO of the Account

  • Operate with significant autonomy in determining how Later approaches, supports, and grows each assigned account.
  • Set the strategic direction for the partnership and mobilize the right internal teams and executive stakeholders to deliver against that vision.
  • Maintain a holistic understanding of account performance, client sentiment, commercial opportunity, stakeholder dynamics, competitive risk, and delivery health.
  • Identify risks and opportunities early and drive cross-functional action before they become material client or commercial issues.
  • Make thoughtful decisions about where Later should invest time, expertise, and resources to maximize the long-term value of the partnership.

Creator & Influencer Strategic Leadership

  • Bring a strong understanding of the creator and influencer ecosystem and how it is evolving across social, media, commerce, and culture.
  • Translate market trends, platform shifts, creator behavior, and performance insights into actionable recommendations for clients.
  • Challenge client thinking when appropriate and help them identify new ways to use creator and influencer marketing to solve business problems.
  • Partner with Strategy, Services, Data, and Product teams to develop differentiated solutions that reflect client objectives and emerging market opportunities.
  • Use client feedback and market insight to help shape Later’s services, products, and strategic priorities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Orchestrate Sales, Strategy, Services, Data, Product, and executive leadership around a unified account strategy and clear client outcomes.
  • Establish clarity on priorities, responsibilities, risks, and opportunities across the teams supporting each account.
  • Partner closely with delivery leadership to ensure strategic objectives, client expectations, and commercial commitments remain aligned.
  • Ensure Later shows up to the client as one integrated strategic partner rather than a collection of individual teams.
  • Escalate and resolve issues appropriately while maintaining executive-level ownership of the relationship.

What success looks like:

  • Enterprise clients consistently renew, expand, and deepen their partnership with Later.
  • Clients view you as a trusted advisor who proactively brings insights—not just solutions.
  • Executive stakeholders engage you early in strategic planning and decision-making.
  • Internal teams see you as a clear, prepared, and reliable partner who elevates execution.
  • Client feedback and insights directly influence product improvements and innovation.

Industry & Market Influence

  • Stay close to developments across influencer marketing, the creator economy, social platforms, measurement, commerce, and digital marketing.
  • Bring relevant industry intelligence and competitive insight into client conversations and account strategy.
  • Represent Later at relevant industry events, executive forums, panels, and strategic networking opportunities.
  • Help strengthen Later’s position as a trusted voice in creator and influencer marketing.

What you bring:

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic account management, customer success, or enterprise sales, with direct ownership of revenue retention and growth.
  • Proven experience working with enterprise brands in influencer or social marketing.
  • Demonstrated success navigating complex enterprise buying cycles and multi-stakeholder decision-making environments.
  • Track record of building trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and anticipating organizational changes.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to command executive-level conversations.
  • Strong operational discipline and time management skills to deliver against KPIs and defined business outcomes.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, Data, and Delivery teams.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support key client relationships.

How we work: 

  • We will do whatever it takes to win: We win when our customers and creators win. We bring full commitment to outcomes that matter, not just effort.
  • We have no limit to our aspiration: We think big, push beyond what seems possible, and refuse to let conventional thinking set the ceiling.
  • We are relentless: We keep going. Through ambiguity, setbacks, and competing priorities, we find a way forward.
  • We deeply understand our business: If we don’t have the knowledge, we figure it out. We take ownership of understanding how Later works and what drives results.
  • We take our work seriously, but not ourselves: We bring rigor and accountability without ego, and we make space for each other to do our best work. 

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted. 

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Salary Range: 

$175,000- $225,000 OTE

*Co-op team members, independent contractors, and freelancers are not eligible for company benefits. 

#LI-Hybrid  #LI-Remote

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located. 

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or age. Please let us know if you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process.
